world_seed.tone: Atmospheric, mercantile, and heavy with humidity
world_seed.visual_direction: Storm-gray canvas, celadon instruments, electric-yellow kite silk, and wet charcoal floors

genre: meteorological night market, climate craft, delivery disputes
premise: In the shadow of the Great Weather Engine, vendors trade unfinished atmospheric phenomena before they are released into the global sky.
simulation_objective: Facilitate the trade and stabilization of volatile weather lots while managing the social friction of competing climate interests.
economy_focus: The sale of high-value, high-risk weather canisters and the tools required to contain them.
exploration_focus: Navigating the shifting visibility and environmental hazards of the market rooms.
visual_style: Top-down pixel art with heavy saturation on electric yellow and celadon against dark, wet backgrounds.

social_rules: No weather lot may be released within market limits without a Level 4 permit.
Bargaining is mandatory; accepting the first price is considered an insult to the craft.
Magenta thread boundaries are absolute; crossing one without a guide is a finable offense.
All leaks must be reported to the nearest Porter or Inspector immediately.
player_entry_points: Arriving as a junior weather broker at the Sky-Watch Commons.
Starting as a kite-pilot apprentice in the Gale Corridor.
Being hired as a temporary guard for the Monsoon Gallery.
conflict_hooks: A major fog canister has ruptured in the Bottling Yard, and the Inspector is on his way.
Raines is attempting to buy out the Hail Song Archive to turn it into a rain reservoir.
Gale has lost a high-value delivery in the Gale Corridor and needs help recovering it.

gameplay_loops.label: The Trade Loop
gameplay_loops.summary: Acquire unfinished weather, stabilize it with alchemical agents, and sell it to brokers in the Gallery.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Canisters decay over time and must be sold or stabilized quickly.

gameplay_loops.label: The Delivery Loop
gameplay_loops.summary: Transport canisters across the market using kites or hand trucks while avoiding environmental hazards.
gameplay_loops.pressure: High winds and low visibility make transport dangerous.

visual_canon.lighting: Low-ambient night with sharp, localized glows from lanterns and electric-yellow silk.
visual_canon.world_prompt_prefix: Strict top-down pixel art, Night Market of Unfinished Weather, wet charcoal floors, celadon instruments, electric-yellow accents, no text.
visual_canon.sprite_prompt_prefix: Strict top-down pixel art character, weather market attire, storm-gray and celadon palette.

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Characters wear heavy, waterproof layers in storm-gray and charcoal, accented by the colors of their trade (yellow for pilots, celadon for vendors).
visual_consistency_rules: All characters must have at least one celadon or electric-yellow accessory.
Footwear must appear wet or muddy.
No character may have visible text on their clothing.
